name: Nibl v1.29.0
body:
## Nibl v1.29.0

This covers items 3, 4, 8, 9 and 10 from the app review, plus three additions: food times and dates, a more focused search, and editable past fasts.

### 3. Requests that can't break
Eight request bodies in `SparkyApiClient` were built by joining strings, and only `"` was escaped. A food name with a `\`, a line break or a tab, or a NaN or ∞ number, produced invalid JSON. Sparky rejected it every time, so the entry never synced. All eight now use `buildJsonObject`, and non-finite numbers are sent as 0 (`putNum`).

### 4. Encrypted Sparky login
- **Storage:** the Sparky token and API key are now stored encrypted (`enc1:` prefix) with the same Keystore AES-GCM key as the AI keys.
- **Migration:** plain-text values from older versions are still read, and are encrypted at app start (`migrateSecrets`).
- **Backups:** a backup restored onto another phone holds only ciphertext, so there you sign in again.
- **Keystore unavailable:** the value is kept as before rather than losing the login.

### 8. Only the history that's needed
- **Home screen:** it no longer keeps every food entry ever logged in memory. It reads the window around the selected day: the TDEE's 28 days, or the chart range if longer. Recent meals read the last 45 days.
- **Reports:** they read their range plus the 28 days before it, instead of the full history.

### 9. R8 shrinking
- **Size:** the release APK goes from **40.9 MB to 27.4 MB**.
- **What's kept:** the app's own classes stay whole and nothing is renamed (`-dontobfuscate`). Room, kotlinx.serialization and reflection behave as in debug builds, and crash traces stay readable. Only unused library code is removed.
- **Verified:** `assembleRelease` with R8 builds cleanly on the final code.

### 10. Smaller files
- **API client:** `SparkyApiClient.kt` goes from 2,620 to about 1,050 lines. Its areas move to extension functions in `SparkyWaterWeightApi.kt`, `SparkyMealsApi.kt`, `SparkyFoodLibraryApi.kt`, `SparkyAiApi.kt` and `SparkyModels.kt`. Call sites are unchanged apart from added imports.
- **Diary:** `DiaryScreen.kt` goes from 2,417 to 1,440 lines. The meal cards, food rows, inline editor and shortcuts move to `DiaryMealCards.kt`.

### Food times and logging to any date and time
- **Default time:** food logged for today is stamped with the time it was logged. This happens in `commitMultiAdd`, so quick add, voice and photo logging get it too.
- **Tray:** a "When" chip ("Today · now") opens a picker:
  - quick days (yesterday, today, tomorrow);
  - a calendar with day arrows;
  - a time you type, with **Now** and **No time** buttons.

  Picking a day ahead turns the tray into planning, as before.
- **Edit sheet:** the date chips and the free-text `YYYY-MM-DD` field are replaced by one date-and-time control.
- **Diary rows:** each food shows its time ("8:15 AM • 150g • P…").

### Search gets out of the way
While you're typing, or a search is showing results:
- The title, the five add buttons and the meal chips fold into one slim line: "Logging to Breakfast · Today · now". The meal can still be changed from the tray.
- The "Searching online databases…" row becomes a thin progress bar.
- The when chip hides along with the tray's other extras.

| Searching | When chip |
|---|---|
| ![](https://github.com/flexingg/nibl/blob/ccr-7457ffc3-v4x9b1/docs/screenshots/search-focus.png?raw=true) | ![](https://github.com/flexingg/nibl/blob/ccr-7457ffc3-v4x9b1/docs/screenshots/when-chip.png?raw=true) |

### Editing past fasts
- **Opening it:** tap a fast in the history, or its pencil, to edit its start and end with the same date-and-time picker.
- **While editing:** the length updates live, and impossible times can't be saved (ending before it starts, in the future, or lasting over two weeks).
- **Target end:** it moves with the start.
- **Sparky refusing:** `updateFast` used to report success even when Sparky refused the change, which the next refresh then silently undid. It now reports Sparky's error.

### Testing
- **New tests:**
  - JSON escaping: odd characters, NaN and ∞, checked by parsing the request Sparky receives.
  - Encrypted credentials: stored encrypted, legacy plain text read and migrated, unreadable after a restore elsewhere.
  - `EatenAt` labels and time parsing, and the diary row time.
  - Today's food stamped with a time, other days not.
  - The search screen's focus mode, and logging at a picked day and time (stored `19:30:00`).
  - Validation of fast edits.
- **Full suite:** 442 tests ran with 2 failures. Both fail on `main` too and aren't touched here:
  - `HomeLayoutUiTest.draggingASectionMovesItAndSwitchesHideThem`;
  - `HomeLayoutTest.sectionsAddedLaterSlotInAtTheirDefaultPlace`, a stale expectation from before the Fasting section existed.
- **Fixed along the way:**
  - two stale search test assertions that expected "Log 2 to Breakfast" text after the Add/Log split;
  - two Robolectric tests that lacked `@GraphicsMode(NATIVE)`, which broke the native runtime for the suites after them.
- **Not tested on a device:** the R8 build, the date-and-time picker sheets, and the fast edit sheet. Compose dialogs can't be render-tested under Robolectric here.

Version 1.29.0 (58).
